newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NFI 11 PLN 20 mln CP issue fully bought.
newsitem.headline: Polish NFI 11 PLN 20 mln CP issue fully bought.

text.p: The 20-million-zloty, three- month commercial paper issue begun last week by National Investment Fund (NFI) No 11 in Poland's mass privatisation programme has been fully bought, the fund's spokesman said.
Maciej Tekielski told Reuters on Tuesday that the proceeds would help capitalise some of the fund's firms but he would not give information on the rate of interest.
The CP programme is the first among funds in the mass privatisation scheme in which shares of some 500 mid-sized companies are allocated to 15 NFIs run by foreign and domestic management firms.

The 26 million Poles who bought a participation unit in the scheme will have the opportunity to exchange it for 15 shares, one in each fund, which are expected to start trade on the Warsaw bourse in the first half of this year.
